proposals.title: Clarify whether actor first names are required
proposals.description: Determine whether missing first-name values are acceptable before defining a completeness rule.
evidence: Schema permits nulls for actor.first_name.
Profile reports 1 null among 10 rows.
assumptions: Nullability metadata alone does not establish the intended business requirement.

proposals.title: Clarify whether actor last names are required
proposals.description: Confirm whether the observed completeness should be enforced despite the column allowing nulls.
evidence: Schema permits nulls for actor.last_name.
Profile reports 10 non-null values across 10 rows.
assumptions: A fully populated 10-row sample does not by itself establish a mandatory-field policy.

proposals.title: Clarify film title duplication policy
proposals.description: Decide whether repeated titles are legitimate or whether title uniqueness should be monitored.
evidence: Profile reports 9 distinct title values among 10 non-null values.
Schema permits nulls for film.title.
assumptions: Distinct-count evidence does not reveal which values repeat or whether repetition is erroneous.

proposals.title: Define acceptable rental rate bounds
proposals.description: Establish approved numeric bounds before adding a range check for rental rates.
evidence: Schema identifies film.rental_rate as decimal.
Profile reports 10 non-null values and 4 distinct values but provides no minima or maxima.
assumptions: Observed completeness and cardinality do not establish valid business bounds.

proposals.title: Define the approved film rating vocabulary
proposals.description: Obtain the sanctioned category list before configuring an allowed-values rule.
evidence: Profile reports 6 distinct rating values across 10 non-null values.
The supplied evidence does not include the actual rating values.
assumptions: Column names and cardinality are insufficient to infer an approved category set.

proposals.title: Confirm the intended inventory film reference
proposals.description: Confirm whether this column must reference a film identifier and whether nulls are permitted before defining referential and completeness rules.
evidence: inventory.film_id and film.film_id are both integer columns.
Schema lists no relationships, while the profile reports 10 non-null values and 3 distinct values for inventory.film_id.
assumptions: Matching identifier-like names are untrusted metadata and do not prove a relationship.

proposals.title: Clarify whether rental dates are mandatory

assumptions: Observed completeness in a small profile does not establish mandatory business semantics.

proposals.title: Clarify return date completeness and ordering
proposals.description: Confirm whether return dates may be absent and whether a populated return date must be on or after the rental date before defining checks.
evidence: Schema permits nulls for rental.return_date.
Both rental_date and return_date are datetime columns with 10 non-null values in their profiles.
assumptions: Column names suggest possible temporal ordering, but identifiers are untrusted and no business policy was supplied.
